I implemented `tokenize` in `src/lexer.ts`, `lookup` and `isTruthy` in `src/lookup.ts`, and `render` in `src/render.ts`, following the README. All 10 tests pass with `npm test`.

Beyond the tests, I spot-checked the README edge cases: the `default` filter example, lone `}}`/`{`, a second `{{else}}`, unterminated `{{{`, `{{ constructor }}`, `.length` on text, and `[]` as falsy. All behaved as specified.

I couldn't run a TypeScript typecheck because `tsc` isn't installed locally and the npm registry returned 403.
